claim_text: The 2021 consensus restricted the NF1 family-history criterion to a parent meeting NF1 criteria; affected siblings or offspring alone no longer qualify, because affected siblings alone should prompt consideration of CMMRD and a single criterion plus an affected child suggests mosaic NF1.
notes: Full text (PMC8354850). Modified Delphi expert consensus (74/76 experts); rubric forbids expert_opinion at strength >=4, so capped at 2. Recommendation, not an empirical finding. | Grounded by Otto via RTX-KG2c PloverDB + SRI Node Normalizer, accessed 2026-11-18. Diagnostic criterion refinement. Subject and object are same disease (family history context). CMMRD=MONDO:0031219 mentioned as differential.
source_title: Revised diagnostic criteria for neurofibromatosis type 1 and Legius syndrome: an international consensus recommendation
rejection_reason: Multiple issues: (1) self-referential semantic triple — subject and object are both 'neurofibromatosis type 1' (MONDO:0018975), which is semantically meaningless as an ASSOCIATED_WITH edge; (2) phenotype_association requires Phenotype in related_nodes but only Disease nodes are present.
